trigger: If ruiz_spared: Ruiz arrives on the radio, then in person, with two deserters.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The grounded transmitter crackles. A familiar voice, on the plant's old frequency.

nodes.speaker: ruiz
nodes.text: Engineer Two to anyone at Peavine. Ironwood's gone dark. Kessler says hold the yard. Half of us are walking.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: An hour later, three soldiers come up the road with their hands visible. Ruiz is limping. Hip never healed right.

nodes.speaker: ruiz
nodes.text: Kessler's holding the Sparks yard with whoever's left. He wants your plant. He'll come for it in winter.

nodes.speaker: deserter
nodes.text: Ma'am says you're the mechanic who saved her. We're done with orders. We'll carry stuff. We're good at carrying.

nodes.speaker: ruiz
nodes.text: No price. I owe you. And I'd rather fix something than shoot it. That's all I've got.

nodes.speaker: ruiz
nodes.text: Engineer Two, reporting. ...Unofficially. There's an Ironwood detail out at Dixie Valley. I know their sergeant.

nodes.speaker: ruiz
nodes.text: Okay. Understood. We'll head north. Watch for Kessler. He doesn't forgive.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: At dawn, the sky is brown. By noon, grey flakes are falling. They don't melt on your hand. It isn't snow.
